looks_like_me_why: Overall this is a good likeness — the hair color and curl, face shape and general skin tone are captured well, and the character carries my expression and posture in several close-ups (pages with clear face shots: 1, 2, 5, 9, 10, 15, 16). It’s clearly the same person stylized into a cartoon kid: big eyes, softened features and slightly exaggerated proportions. That stylization is fine for a picture book, but small details wobble across pages (some images smooth or shift shading/tones and a couple of frames feel like a different, more stereotypical ‘Jack’).
rings_true_why: The text follows the classic Jack and the Beanstalk beats and the pacing/readability fits a children's picture book — simple sentences, clear cause-and-effect, and the images match the lines closely. It feels coherent, playful and faithful to the fairy tale while working as a kid-friendly read-aloud.
professional_why: The art is polished and consistent in style, colors, and composition — the pages look like they came from the same illustrator. Framing, lighting and character expressions are high quality. I’d feel comfortable printing or gifting this; it’s on par with published children’s picture books rather than a rough AI demo.
not_good: A few continuity hiccups: the hero's look shifts a little between pages (some panels feel slightly different in face detail or proportions, which can read as different people — page 20 in particular shows an extra boy character that confuses who 'Jack' actually is). The five beans look a bit like candy when they fly out the window (page 6/7) — a stylistic choice but jarring. Minor detail inconsistencies (small costume/necklace/piercing treatments and skin shading) crop up across pages and could be tightened.
liked: I liked that the app handled a non‑traditional Jack really respectfully — teal curly hair, expression and personality come through, which matters for representation in kids’ books. The images are warm, expressive and funny (giant’s kitchen, the sleeping scene, the singing harp) and the color palette and composition are delightful.
